entity.description: Nakagami Yousuke (なかがみ ようすけ Nakagami Yousuke?) is the character from the tenth Street Fighter Laboratory corner. A young man who hardly comes out from the home he got from his parents. Having multiple real estates, he seems not to be troubled with money. For some reason he is training his body with muscle training. It seems he shatters PC monitors with an intense punch while saying "Yo guys, let's meet next week!"
